title: Refactor icon spacing and responsive axis constraints for tables & charts
creator: Maya Patel
description: Audit and refactor icon spacing across button and table components and introduce a deterministic auto-fit rule for chart/table axis labels. Goal: reduce visual jitter caused by mixed instance overrides, consolidate spacing tokens into semantic variables, and guarantee readable axis labels across responsive breakpoints. Deliver a migration plan, Figma library updates, and a publish checklist that minimizes downstream CSS churn for frontend.
acceptance_criteria: All button and table variants use new semantic spacing tokens (icon-gap-xs/sm/md) and no direct pixel overrides remain in library instances
Chart and table axis label components apply a single auto-fit constraint that toggles truncation, line-wrap, or scale-to-fit depending on width thresholds
Figma library publish passes gating checklist and is rolled out behind a feature flag in console-frontend
Frontend token mapping document and PR provided with migration notes and deprecation timeline
tasks: Run token audit across components to identify ad-hoc icon spacing (DESIGN: audit spreadsheet)
Prototype auto-fit constraint for axis label component with 3 behaviors: wrap, ellipsize, scale-down text
Define semantic tokens: icon-gap-xs/sm/md, axis-label-size, axis-label-line-height, axis-label-truncation-threshold
Update Figma library instances and create conversion playbook for component consumers
Create frontend PR mapping new tokens to CSS variables and a migration shim (design-system/frontend#842)
Run cross-team review with Platform UI and Charts ownership; incorporate feedback
Publish library with gated rollout and monitor publish dashboard for regressions
decisions: Use semantic spacing tokens rather than absolute pixel tokens to make responsive behavior predictable
Axis auto-fit default behavior: wrap when container width >= 160px, ellipsize when 80-160px, scale-down text only as last resort under 80px
Deprecate legacy icon-left-compact and icon-right-compact variants in favor of a single 'icon-hint' variant that adapts via tokens
Keep a short-lived deprecated token mapping layer for frontend (6 weeks) before removal
